Accepts Resignation of Michael Zaleski as Deputy Highway Superintendent Resolution #9 Councilman Hubbard: “Accepts Resignation of Michael Zaleski as Deputy Highway Superintendent, so moved.” Councilman Beyrodt: “Seconded.” Supervisor Aguiar: “Vote please.” The Vote: “Kern yes; Rothwell, yes; Beyrodt, yes; Hubbard.” Councilman Hubbard : “I just want to explain he has to resign from his old post to take his newly elected post. When I first saw all these I said all these people are leaving us but that’s what it is so the people out there know, yes.” Vote Continued: “Aguiar, yes. Resolution adopted.”

Reappoints Town Historian Resolution #12 Councilman Kern: “Reappoints Town Historian, so moved.” Councilman Hubbard: “Seconded.” Supervisor Aguiar: “Vote please.” The Vote: “Kern, yes; Rothwell, yes; Beyrodt.” Councilman Beyrodt: “What a great job she does and I’m glad to reappoint her and I’m glad she’ll continue the job, yes.” Vote Continued: “Hubbard.” Councilman Hubbard : “I see a lot of these things on the Remembering Riverhead website about who remembers, blah, blah, blah. If you go to our town historian or you go to Richard Wines, I know of two better people, I don’ t know of two better people that have the history right on the top of their head and if they don’t they’ll find it for you, so I definitely vote yes. Ms. Case does a great job for us.” Vote Continued: “Aguiar.” Supervisor Aguiar : “Yes, absolutely. She’s always in my office and finding things and sharing stories and I had a nice tour not too long ago of the facility and thank you for everything you do for so many years here.”

Accepts Highway Superintendent’s Personnel Report & Request for Town Board Resolution to Promote an Automotive Equipment Operator Resolution #42 Councilman Beyrodt: “Accepts Highway Superintendent’s Personnel Report and Request for Town Board Resolution to Promote an Automotive Equipment Operator, so moved.” Councilman Rothwell: “Seconded.” Supervisor Aguiar: “Vote please.” The Vote: “Kern, yes; Rothwell, yes; Beyrodt, yes; Hubbard.” Councilman Hubbard: “I just want to say as a group for all of these instead of individually, they are a har dworking crew up at the highway department. Reappoints Member to the Town of Riverhead Zoning Board of Appeals (Leroy Barnes) Resolution #44 Councilman Kern: “Reappoints Member to the Town of Riverhead Zoning Board of Appeals (Leroy Barnes), so moved.” Councilman Hubbard: “Seconded.” Supervisor Aguiar: “Vote please.” The Vote: “Kern, yes; Rothwell, yes; Beyrodt.” Councilman Beyrodt: “Leroy is an asset to the ZBA, and a wealth of history and knowledge and I say yes overwhelmingly.” Vote Continued: “Hubbard.” Councilman Hubbard: “Exactly what Frank said, yes.” Vote Continued: “Aguiar.” Supervisor Aguiar : “Leroy, we look forward to you. I know you served us very well on the ZBA. Your knowledge is impressive, your smile is infectious as we see he’s always smiling and thank you for staying on board.” Diane Wilhelm: “Resolution adopted.”

Ratifies Appointment of Joann Waski to Serve as Chairperson of the Planning Board of the Town of Riverhead Resolution #45 Councilman Hubbard: “Ratifies Appointment of Joann Waski to Serve as Chairperson of the Planning Board of the Town of Riverhead, so moved.” Councilman Beyrodt: “Seconded.” Supervisor Aguiar: “Vote please.” The Vote: “Kern, yes; Rothwell, yes; Beyrodt.” Councilman Beyrodt : “Again such a wealth of knowledge, information, history. Couldn’t be a better person for this spot, yes.” Vote Continued: “Hubbard.” Councilman Hubbard: “I agree with what Frank said, absolutely yes.” Vote Continued: “Aguiar.” Supervisor Aguiar: “Yes, I’ve gotten to know her throughout the years and her ethics are beyond reproach. She’s smart, she’s not scared to take a stance and follow through and I commend her ability to work with the commu nity. She’s well known in the community. She’s a businesswoman. She has a business in the community, and I can’t think of a better person to serve in this position.” Diane Wilhelm: “Resolution adopted.”

Appoints Official Newspaper for the Town of Riverhead Resolution #46 Councilman Beyrodt: “Appoints Official Newspaper for the Town of Riverhead, so moved.” Councilman Rothwell:“Seconded.” Supervisor Aguiar: “Vote please.” The Vote: “Kern, yes; Rothwell, yes; Beyrodt, yes; Hubbard, yes; Aguiar.” Supervisor Aguiar: “Yes, and this year we added Dan’s newspaper which is readily available, and we welcome them on board, and we’ll be sending you our press releases also, so welcome aboard and all the other newspapers and I vote yes.” Diane Wilhelm: “Resolution adopted.”

Maintains Policy of Non-Discrimination Resolution #49 Councilman Hubbard: “Maintains Policy of Non-Discrimination, so moved.” Councilman Beyrodt: “Seconded.” Supervisor Aguiar: “Vote please.” The Vote: “Kern, yes; Rothwell, yes; Beyrodt, yes; Hubbard, yes; Aguiar.” Supervisor Aguiar: “I would like to amend this resolution. It says here Yvette Aguiar, Supervisor will be the person to coordinate and comply with this requirement. In general, and usually in civil service and in the public facilities, the person in charge with making s ure discriminatory or sexual harassment training and anything along that nature is the personnel director. They know how to reach the individual. So, I would like to be able to amend this to make it personnel director. They’re the ones who have all the rec ords, the ability and that is their job to manage personnel and concerning training. It’s not the Supervisor’s officer to personally get involved and dictate training and keep data basis. So, I hope I have the support of the Board to amend this to the personnel director.” Councilman Rothwell: “I’ll second your motion to amend.” Supervisor Aguiar: “Diane, can you take a vote?” Diane Wilhelm: “All over again?” Councilman Rothwell: “To amend.” The Vote: “Kern, yes; Rothwell, yes; Beyrodt, yes to amend; Hubbard, yes to amend; Aguiar, yes to amend. Resolution adopted.”

Reassigns the Salary of an Account Clerk Resolution #55 Councilman Hubbard: “Resolution 55 I would like to bring up from the floor. I would like to make a motion to reassign the salary of a n account clerk. The reason this is being brought off the floor is that it was inadvertently left out. It should have been in with all the others so I would like to make a motion to Reassign the Salary of an Account Clerk, so moved.” Supervisor Aguiar: “I second it.” Supervisor Aguiar: “Vote please.” The Vote: “Kern, yes; Rothwell, yes; Beyrodt, yes; Hubbard, yes; Aguiar.” Supervisor Agui ar: “Yes, and just so you know, to move something off the floor you need five votes and if one person is missing you don’t have your five votes and I know there’s been some confusion here. You need five to move it and if one person is missing or two are, it does not come off the floor, but now that we have the five votes Diane, can you please take the vote on this resolution?” Diane Wilhelm: "Resolution 55 is taken off the floor.” Councilman Hubbard: “Reassigns the Salary of an Account Clerk, so moved.” Councilman Rothwell:“Seconded.” The Vote: “Kern, yes; Rothwell, yes; Beyrodt, yes; Hubbard, yes; Aguiar, yes. Resolution 55 is adopted.”
